title: Smoke vents located in an exterior wall.
officialText: Where the exterior wall serves as part of a shaft enclosure or where a smoke vent duct penetrates the exterior wall of the building, no openings shall be located in the wall within a distance of 30 feet (9144 mm) vertically above the vent opening, nor within 5 feet (1524 mm) on either side of the vent opening.
